topic: Someone finds their college application essay published as an example
text: I must admit, discovering my college application essay showcased as an example was a bit of a surprise. Yet, it's a good kind of surprise, isn’t it? It means someone found value in the words I wrote, in the thoughts I poured onto the page. It’s a reminder that when we put our best effort into something, it can resonate with others in unexpected ways. Perhaps it’ll inspire or guide someone else on their journey. It’s a nice feeling, knowing that something personal can serve a broader purpose. I’m proud of the work I did and grateful for the opportunity to maybe help others along the way.
